title: Chronography (fragments, preserved by George Syncellus)
author: Julius Africanus
summary: Africanus' world chronicle, which cites Thallus and Phlegon on the darkness at the crucifixion and argues it could not have been an eclipse.
note: Checked via secondary summaries; Thallus' and Phlegon's own words survive only secondhand.

title: Thallus and Phlegon on the darkness at the crucifixion
author: Akroterion (journal article)
summary: A scholarly assessment of whether Thallus and Phlegon can be linked to the crucifixion darkness.
